title: Infinite log-convexity conjecture for the Baxter numbers
statement:
Let $\{B_n\}_{n\geq 1}$ be the sequence of Baxter numbers. **The Baxter-number infinite log-convexity conjecture.** The sequence

$$
\{B_n\}_{n\geq 1}
$$

is infinitely log-convex. The paper proves eventual $3$-log-convexity from index $882712$ onward, but does not prove $3$-log-convexity from the beginning; the full infinite log-convexity claim remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.05873

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2025).
source_name: Hanqian Fang, Candice X. T. Zhang and James J. Y. Zhao, “Analytic properties arising from the Baxter numbers”, arXiv:2505.05873 (2025).
